description: This file contains unit tests for the PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector class, focusing on its behavior in filtering silo addresses based on preferred metadata criteria within the Orleans distributed runtime project.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirectorTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector class, verifying its creation, filtering logic, and behavior under different metadata configurations.

methods.name: CanBeCreated
methods.description: Tests that an instance of PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector can be successfully created.

methods.name: CanBeCalled
methods.description: Verifies that the Filter method of the director returns a non-null, non-empty result when invoked.

methods.name: FiltersToAllWhenNoEntry
methods.description: Ensures that if there's no metadata entry for a silo, the filter does not exclude any addresses, returning all.

methods.name: FiltersOnSingleMetadata
methods.description: Tests filtering behavior when only a single metadata key is used, verifying the number of results matches expected based on configured metadata.

methods.name: FiltersOnMultipleMetadata
methods.description: Verifies filtering behavior when multiple metadata keys are used, including correct filtering based on multiple criteria.
